name: Doctor Holli'dae
guide_text: You don't have to hero power every turn, only when you have 1 gold left over. For example, turn 2 you should still just level and not hero power.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy is very powerful. Buy most 5 drops minions and use [[Mooneater]] or [[Nalaa the Redeemer]] to scale. After you buy 9 minions with the first buddy, golden it to reset the counter, so you get 18 more spells.
